name: BINGO LOCO
description:
⭐ Bingo Loco – The Wildest Bingo Party in Oslo 🎉

Looking for the ultimate party experience in the UK and Europe? Welcome to Bingo Loco — the interactive live event where a huge night out meets the madness of bingo. We’ve taken a classic game and flipped it on its head, creating a full-blown party experience packed with DJs, dance-offs, lip-sync battles, confetti showers, outrageous prizes and unforgettable moments. This isn’t bingo as you know it… this is a party with a bingo twist!

After selling out shows in over 200 cities worldwide, Bingo Loco is bringing its legendary chaos to Oslo for one unforgettable night. Expect massive throwback anthems, hilarious games, epic prizes and an atmosphere that will have you dancing, laughing and making memories from start to finish.

🔥 Highlights

🌍 Global Hit: From Australia to North America and across Europe, Bingo Loco has become one of the world's biggest interactive party experiences — and now Oslo is getting its turn!

🕺 Insane Energy: Get ready for a high-octane stage show featuring rave rounds, dance battles, DJs, crowd games, lip-sync moments and confetti explosions.

🎁 Crazy Prizes: Forget boring prizes — Bingo Loco is famous for unexpected wins, wild surprises and prizes you’ll never see coming!

🎶 Epic Throwbacks: Sing your heart out to the biggest 80s, 90s and 00s anthems — from ABBA and Britney to all your favourite party classics.

😂 Energetic Hosts: Our legendary MCs bring nonstop fun, outrageous energy and plenty of surprises throughout the night.

📍 General Info

⏳ Duration: Approx. 3 hours

📌 Location: Vulkan Arena, Oslo

👤 Age Limit: 18+ (Valid ID required)

⚠️ Disclaimer: Expect adult humour, strong language and outrageous entertainment.

⚡ Light Effects Warning: This event may feature strobe lighting and flashing lights.

♿ Accessibility: Please contact the venue directly for accessibility options.

🪑 Seating: Seating is first come, first served. Get your squad together and arrive early to claim the best spots in the house! Tables usually seat 8–10 guests, so be ready to make some new friends and share the party. Seating arrangements can vary by venue, and some locations may offer reserved seating — please check your ticket details for specific information.
